conditions: a GitHub runner's four CPUs: the load tool on one, the stand-in model on one, the gateway on two, calls sent at a fixed rate over 64 connections whatever the answers do, each timed from when it was due. Switched on in Nave: routes by model, falls back, takes OpenAI's and Anthropic's formats, keeps spend by key. No key check, no request log, no limits. Switched on in sub2api: routes by group to upstream accounts, takes OpenAI's format and sends it on as a Responses call, checks the caller's key, counts usage and quota in PostgreSQL. Simple mode, as its docs give for one owner
